API_draft.name: make_source_dc_innovation_target
API_draft.postcompose_separate_inputs: Only the application stage receives existing baseline B, fixed P, measured matching T(P), and existing pilot activity. These cannot influence target or its state.

frozen_constants.sigma_numerical_floor: float64 eps * max(1,maxabs(current valid frame interior))
frozen_constants.extra_activation_minimum: none: first valid frame current target; compare innovation whenever at least1 prior mean exists

source_mean_noise_model.ROI: raw frame[5:-5,5:-5,:], requires nonempty interior with width>=3 for proper-complex coefficients
source_mean_noise_model.M: number of pixels in that fixed interior
source_mean_noise_model.mean: mu_i = float64 spatial mean of each current interior RGB channel
source_mean_noise_model.FFT: F_i = rfft2(interior - mu_i, axes spatial) / M
source_mean_noise_model.selected_noise_coefficients: All y rows and strictly interior positive x columns. Exclude x=0 and even-width x=Nyquist, so retained coefficients are proper-complex in the nominal spatial IID model. No signal-dependent mask or scene selection.
source_mean_noise_model.sigma_RGB: sigma_i,c = max(median(abs(F_i[:,:,c]) over the fixed selected columns) * sqrt(M/log(2)), numerical floor)
source_mean_noise_model.scope: Plug-in nominal spatial IID Gaussian variance for each RGB mean; actual independent pixel count unknown. Off-grid/dense texture, shared spatial noise and correlated RGB/time can invalidate it. Source-adaptive sigma is not an independence or confidence proof.

algorithm_exact_order: Validate shape/dtype metadata. Shape errors raise; per-frame invalid source/control/exposure yields target_valid=false, clears target history, and preserves existing output baseline exactly at application. No clipping or invented target.

Clear DC mean/variance history on reset, exact jitter change, a changed supplied exposure value, or a new source-only epoch boundary. Exposure absent means unknown. Optional epoch must be an integer between0 and frame index and cannot reference future data.

For a valid frame compute mu_i and q_i from only current observed interior. Any nonfinite/negative/>65504 source sample or channel mu_i<=1e-4 rejects this target and clears the DC history. No division by radiance mean occurs.
Let m<=63 be valid preceding means in the current DC epoch. If m=0, target=mu_i, innovation=false, nominal target variance=q_i.

If m>0: prior_mu = unweighted mean of preceding mu_j; prior_q = sum(q_j)/m^2; threshold_RGB = 3*sqrt(q_i+prior_q). Illumination innovation is any channel abs(mu_i-prior_mu)>threshold_RGB. Equality stays in the quiet branch.
On innovation: clear all preceding DC means/variances, set new DC epoch to current frame, target=mu_i, target variance=q_i. This is a source-mean change flag, not an identified physical-light event.

Otherwise target = unweighted mean of preceding means plus current mu_i; nominal target variance=(sum(q_j)+q_i)/(m+1)^2. SharedRGB epoch/reset decisions preserve a single coefficient-history interval across channels.
Append current valid mu_i and q_i; retain at most63 for the next frame. Thus each target uses at most64 inclusive observations. Never append target instead of observed mean.

Source means during the frozen pilot's first8 raw inactive warmup feed this DC-only estimator. There is no extra target warmup or spectral/residual state change. Metadata source-epoch cuts still apply. The final output remains exact baseline on existing inactive pilot frames.

Application: fixed C = B + active*(P-T(P)); for target_valid and existing pilot active apply uniform whole-frame RGB shift target_i - float64 mean(C_i[5:-5,5:-5,:]). Otherwise return exact B_i. Target constructor receives none of C/B/P/T(P).

Optional mandatory reported safe output uses existing atomic wholeRGB invalidpixel->exactbaseline rule after the shift. Baseline invalid raises. No clamp, no second DC correction after fallback; report target closure before and after fallback separately.

information_limits: Mean DC fluctuation from true illumination and spatially shared source noise can be observationally identical; this rule cannot identify them.
The anyRGB3SE event is nominal and has no familywise confidence guarantee, especially with plug-in texture-contaminated sigma and RGB/time covariance.
Small/slow illumination changes can lag before a cut. A global history cannot establish correspondence after camera motion, moving light, disocclusion or changing material coverage.
Uniform target shifts address DC only. They cannot repair first8 baseline behavior, nonDC hard support, wrong phase or weak texture loss. Safe fallback can introduce spatial masks and must be scored.

This differs from the already tested source-DC conditioned pilot only in operator location, perRGB ROI uncertainty, and illumination-triggered DC-history cut. It is a narrow combination hypothesis, not a new denoising mechanism or claim of solution.
